My phone battery is on 11 percent and the charger is in my car.

I want to fold Pine Hollow into the 6 pm bulletin with the other districts so we do not cause a traffic jam and panic on that one road for nothing. What goes out to Pine Hollow?

A) A mandatory evacuation order by wireless alert right now
B) The 'be ready' notice in the 6 pm bulletin, same as the other districts
C) Hold off on the Pine Hollow notice until I've talked it over with the incident commander
